Compulsory K5/K6, function notation/domains on printed22/31, numeric-set systematization on printed29 and inequality solution sets on printed23 jointly support the contract. Interval notation is explicit in the printed39 K5 example: this is a bounded operationalization of a compulsory process competence, not a claim that the example is an independent mandatory bullet. K5 explicitly uses formulas and symbols; K6 interprets mathematical statements and subject language. Interpreting common notation and explaining it is a bounded operationalisation. Listed goal examples are illustrative, not a claim that every example is a literal compulsory source item.
Factoring out is explicit in compulsory J8 algebra; checking by multiplication is its elementary inverse verification under K5, not an extra official quotation.

General fractional-expression expansion/cancellation is not established by the compulsory simple fraction-equation line. The complete canonical contract remains intact; the new stage view explicitly selects ratio equations671 instead, with actually demanded ordinary support preserved.

Compulsory J8 trees and path rules plus repeated-dice example, and J10 experiments with/without replacement, support structuring multistage experiments and calculating their probabilities. This is direct topic support with mathematical operationalisation, not support inferred from ancestors.

The full core does not prescribe linear inequalities, so this whole contract is overbroad. Preserve existing equation/probe targets and explicitly select existing error-analysis goal fbcb to preserve compulsory process correction at PDF17/18; its parenthetical examples are bounded operationalizations requiring independent review. Original remains unchanged ordinary support when demanded.

The primary explicitly supports symbolic-to-natural-language translation but not a compulsory conjunction of set, interval and function notation; its only interval word denotes statistical class widths. Select the existing narrower notation/variable goals927/c911, both already targets. Preserve unchanged ordinary support when actually demanded.

The J7/8 core explicitly expands and collects terms, multiplies sums and uses distribution. Verification follows the prescribed checking/explaining of mathematical procedures; no full source coverage of unrelated algebra goals is implied.

The process standard requires symbolic/formal-to-natural-language translation and correct relation signs. Explaining common notation is a bounded operationalisation; illustrative examples in the goal are not all asserted as literal prescribed source items.
Factoring out appears in the compulsory J7/8 core; distribution and checking/correcting mathematical reasoning jointly support identification, factorisation and inverse verification.

The binding inverse-function and logarithm clauses support switching exponential/logarithmic representations. The same grade explicitly applies exponential knowledge to growth; simple contextual interpretation is their joint operationalization.

Solving a^x=b is a binding sub-bullet of logarithmic inversion. The same-grade growth unit and explicit result-checking/interpreting goals support the stated simple application and verification without extending the equation class.

Grade8 explicitly joins verbal event descriptions with set notation; Grade10 combines events symbolically and uses four-cell tables. A Venn-style set diagram can operationalize those same set relationships, but the primary does not literally require that diagram form.

Compulsory simple fraction equations with ratio example, equivalence transformations and result checks support solving ratio equations with necessary domain conditions and substitution verification as a bounded mathematical operationalization.
Compulsory clear event/outcome distinction and multistage experiment descriptions support outcomes, sample space and suitable events as a bounded operationalization of the prescribed distinctions.

Compulsory identifying/correcting errors and explaining causes on PDF17/18, plus rounding/estimation on PDF24, support the complete typical-error analysis contract. Arithmetic, invalid assumptions and rounding are operationalizations of that process competence, not literal separate mandatory bullets. Independent review must explicitly approve this bounded conjunction.
